confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taiwanese price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which swing with weekends, domestic holidays and July demand. The RBA FX observation could not be verified from an rba.gov.au page in this session, so all fx fields are null.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Taiwanese east-coast tourist towns such as Taitung and Yilan, adjusted to general Taiwan price levels. No single named comparable city was used.
